notes.title: v0.92 - Music & Sounds
notes.notes:
Hello players!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35117979/228b8e115927ff20b2a9dcfed89f281c4112777e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35117979/0ccf610809c3514b7573b1b06a0dcbfa59d2c320.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks to [url=https://www.facebook.com/Two-Stones-Records-165631984366443/]Two Stones Records[/url]...
[b]Sideral version 0.92 arrives with:[/b]
-Added background music for day & night cycle.
-Added ambient background sounds.
-Added sound effects

    Also...
-Rendering Optimization.
-3D Meshes Optimization.
-Fixed some little bugs.

[b]Planned updates:[/b]
-Official Complete Background music By Two Stones Records
-Add Compatibility with SteamVR
-Fix controller sensibility, Buttons issues (need feedback)...
-Night sea reflections optimization

    Also...
-Any other good idea sent by you!

Thank you all !
See you!

notes.title: v0.91 - XBOX Controller & STEAM Controller Compatibility!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35117979/9b5a9dad4fe75dc808be35960ca36760a6e1a7c7.jpg[/img]

-Added compatibility with XBox controller

Comming Updates:

Thank you all!
See you!

notes.title: OPEN FEEDBACK BETA STARTS THIS WEEK !
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35117979/413151e6e239358bab219657b44ded74451e30ca.jpg[/img]

On 24th June 2019, we finnally launch the open beta version of the game for all those who want to enjoy it or participate in the design of new puzzles and minigames for Sideral!

If you think you know some kind of logic game without words or numbers, and want to challange all the players to solve them, make a detailed explanation of how it works and send it to me.

As a open Beta, all improvements, bugs, errors, etc. will be also so much appreciated

All proposals, improvement and ideas in general should be sent to this email:

armagedoomgamesstudio@gmail.com

Best ideas will be implemented to Sideral in the next Updates!

See you!
